overlays.narrative_body: Between ruined stones and predator banners, Red Leopards watches the narrow way into the seventh position. Five victories place him just inside the gate, but the threshold belongs to no one yet. Three Dreaded Snake approaches first. Duckhook follows, then Chili arrives for the consequential Week 13 rematch. Red tests the footing of the terrace. A predator survives by guarding the approach, not merely roaring at it.
overlays.math_scope_note: Still alive after a Week 11 loss; no berth clinched at Week 10.

overlays.narrative_body: The stable gate swings open onto dusty track. Chili holds the eighth seed and refuses to confuse standing outside with being defeated. ObiWan arrives before the three Wings rematches; Red waits in Week 13, when one result could swing both playoff paths. He settles the black brim above his eyes and steps toward the road. The seventh place is not inherited. It must be taken.
